scenario.title: Price-feed glitch
scenario.story: A bad price tick makes the optimizer order every battery to charge at full power.

scenario.title: Stolen key
scenario.story: Someone signs a fleet-wide full discharge with a key that is not on the trust list, posing as the utility.

scenario.title: Replay
scenario.story: A captured 7 AM utility test order is re-sent, with its old epoch and valid signature.

scenario.title: Bad forecast
scenario.story: A broken forecast tells the optimizer to drain every battery to 5% by 9 PM.

scenario.title: Utility opens circuit 3
scenario.story: The utility de-energizes circuit 3 for switching; its homes island.

scenario.title: Market export on a dead line
scenario.story: A market award asks circuit 3 to export while it is de-energized.

scenario.title: Utility emergency (EEA 3)
scenario.story: Valid, signed, priority 0: export 8 kW per home until 8 PM.

scenario.title: Cell tower drops
scenario.story: Tower c2-a goes down; about 300 homes go quiet at once.

scenario.title: Stuck-SOC bug
scenario.story: Most v2.3 units on circuit 4 keep reporting the same SOC while they discharge.

scenario.title: BMS fault
scenario.story: One battery on circuit 1 reports a BMS fault and goes silent.

scenario.title: Rebound at peak
scenario.story: Right after the event the optimizer orders every battery to recharge at full power.

sce.label: SCE default
sce.description: Default pack for an SCE-territory fleet: 20% backup floor (50% for medical homes), 90 s heartbeat, 15 min command age limit, canary for big orders.

installation.label: Installation (strict)
installation.description: Strict military-installation pack: only the utility and the on-site energy manager may command batteries; vendor and market clouds are held; every fleet-wide order goes to a person; 40% floor.

australia.label: Australia DOE (illustrative)
australia.description: Illustrative dynamic-operating-envelope pack: each circuit import/export limit is recomputed every 5 minutes; tighter export at midday (solar), wider in the evening.
